title: UC Davis - Acquisition/Acclimation/Quarantine
author: K.C. Kent Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xfifjke

steps.title: Select and Verify Vendor
steps.instruction: Purchase laboratory rodents from MBP veterinary staff approved vendors (e.g., Harlan Sprague Dawley, Inc., Charles River Laboratories, The Jackson Laboratory, Taconic).

steps.title: Request Non-Approved Vendor Exception
steps.instruction: If using a non-approved commercial vendor or other source, submit the following for review by the MBP veterinarian:

substeps.instruction: Provide written scientific justification of need and evidence of lack of alternative SPF sources to the IACUC.
Provide the source facility's health history of the specific colony to the MBP import/export manager, including the attending veterinarian's name, address, and telephone number.

For U.S. colonies, provide serologic surveillance data sampled within two months of the proposed shipment date demonstrating the colony is free from known zoonotic pathogens (e.g., Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus, Hantan virus) and commonly occurring murine pathogens.
Ensure all rodents are tested for mites, pinworms, and Helicobacter.
Obtain a written statement from the source veterinarian regarding the general overall health of the animals.

steps.title: Submit Shipment Details
steps.instruction: Provide the following information to the import/export manager:

substeps.instruction: Number of animals to be shipped.
Housing/care requirements (e.g., SPF/Barrier housed, conventional housing, own room or multi-room, autoclaved, filter top, single housed or group).
Current state of housing/care at the source facility (e.g., if barrier housed, specify gowning and cage changing procedures).

steps.title: Coordinate Usage and Precautions
steps.instruction: Discuss intended animal usage with the MBP veterinarian to determine necessary precautions.

substeps.instruction: If animals must go to a laboratory or surgical facility prior to quarantine, develop protocols to minimize or preclude inadvertent cross-contamination.

steps.title: Finalize Importation and Payment
steps.instruction: Coordinate final logistics with the import/export manager and purchasing officer.

substeps.instruction: Provide the import/export manager with the invoice address and the account number for animal care (or indicate payment by check).
Contact the purchasing officer and submit a Special Request Form before placing the order.

steps.title: Execute Importation Quarantine
steps.instruction: Place animals in importation quarantine upon arrival for 4-6 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Follow all guidelines posted on the door for entry.
Collect samples from sentinels exposed to dirty bedding and test for the murine pathogens listed previously.
Ensure animals do not leave the quarantine room, although they may be used for research (e.g., breeding) during this period unless exceptions are discussed with the MBP veterinarian.

steps.title: Release Animals from Quarantine
steps.instruction: Wait for negative test results and approval from the MBP veterinarian for the release of animals.

substeps.instruction: The import/export manager will contact the PI once animals are ready for release.
